reuse: Read installed source and invoked native exported functions through supplied fake streams; no upstream implementation copied or ported into product.

tests.network: Supplied fake stream for every call; global fetch throws. No provider/account setup invoked.
cases: Unsplit counts new summary response, excludes historic assistant usage and tokensBefore.
Split with history sums exactly two successful summary responses.
Split without history uses one prefix response.
Success after retry excludes reported usage of failed attempt.
Second-stage failure returns no aggregate despite successful first stage.
Optional reasoning present on only one stage still yields number, so aggregate alone cannot prove full reasoning coverage.

findings.disjointness: For audited native default compaction path, usage is taken from new summary calls, not session totals. tokensBefore is context size, never cost.
findings.incompleteness: retryAssistantCall returns successful/final response only. compact returns usage only after all required summary calls succeed. Aggregate is known reported consumption, not all-attempt/request coverage.
findings.extensions: agent-session accepts extensionCompaction.usage and stores fromHook. Default-path disjointness proof must not be applied to extension-provided or unverified provenance.
findings.identity: Persistent compaction entry has native entry ID, not provider response ID; never synthesize generation or HTTP count.
findings.optionalSplits: combineUsage may zero-fill one missing optional reasoning field; do not infer complete reasoning breakdown from aggregate numeric presence alone.

productDecision: Expose typed known aggregate separately, retain partial/gap. No silent generation-total merge or removal of parse_error solely because compaction_end has usage. No product code changed in this audit.
limits: Installed version only; other CLI/model/version behavior not established.
Fake failure cases prove possible accounting boundaries, not a claim historical paid traces had missing costs.
Previous paid pilot raw HTTP totals remain complete; no retrospective verdict changes.
